context:
Goal: banchi's push-to-main browser run skips what the PR run proved and never runs more than it must.
Problem (rule): decision D215 says a partial PR run writes no pass record. After PR 1094 ran 44 of 64 specs, the push found no record and ran all 64 (run 43384801390, 14 min 46 s). It changes a ruling, so it needs your word.
Based on (read): D215 and run 43384801390; the builder read PR 1094's browser scope, '44 of 64 specs, a genuine narrowing'.
Departs from: D215 writes no record for a partial run — a writes one naming the specs that run covered, and the push runs only the other 20.
Meanwhile: runner 11 asks lane push-skip-proven-tree whether the shared skip (your 729 a) covers a partial run.

options.gain: Push runs 20 specs instead of 64 after a partial PR.
options.how: A partial PR run records which specs it covered; the push runs only the others (20, not 64).
options.label: Write a record naming the covered specs; push runs the rest
options.lose: A new record format and a rewrite of D215.

options.how: Banchi follows the shared skip (item 729 a) and accepts a full push run after a partial PR.
options.label: Keep D215; take the shared proven-tree skip
options.lose: A 64-spec push after every partial PR.

reply: Lane push-skip-proven-tree answered (via runner 11, 12:24 CST Nov 13): 'proven' means a full PR run only. A narrowed run, like banchi's 44 of 64 specs, never proves the tree, so under b the push still runs all 64 after a partial PR. Option a (record naming the covered specs, push runs the other 20) goes beyond the shared form, so it is banchi's own change on top. The lane edits claude-settings only.
short: Banchi: push runs only the specs a partial PR run left out?

shown.label: Write a record naming the covered specs; push runs the rest
Keep D215; take the shared proven-tree skip

title: After a partial banchi PR run, should the push to main run only the browser specs the PR run did not cover?
why: The change is to a banchi ruling; both options cost something you would have to live with.
